organic.title: PRISM: Agentic Retrieval with LLMs for Multi-Hop Question ...
organic.snippet: Abstract Retrieval plays a central role in multi-hop question answering (QA), where answering complex questions requires gathering multiple pieces of evidence. We introduce an Agentic Retrieval System that leverages large language models (LLMs) in a structured loop to retrieve relevant evidence with high precision and recall.
